scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "backend,web" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n "backend,web,mobile" -c "blue,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run start --prefix mobile"
scripts.test:report: npm run test:report --prefix backend && npm run test:report --prefix web && npm run test:report --prefix mobile
